query:
The group moved toward a scan-sharing arrangement so absent members could participate in critiques. What did one member's response in that moment reveal about their actual position, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Margot
B. Yuki
C. Otto
D. Fen
context:
[1] (about=Margot, episodic, t2 @2025-02-08T10:20:00) I see.
[2] (about=Otto, episodic, t2 @2025-02-08T10:18:00) I will say what needs saying. Scanning is a compromise. The tonal range in a wet print does not survive digitisation cleanly. In my experience, the print is the work. I would rather members attended. That said, I understand the practical argument.
[3] (about=Bex, episodic, t2 @2025-02-08T10:22:00) okay but Margot 'I see' could mean anything 😂 are you against it or just... thinking?? also I fully support the scan-sharing, it feels like it would make the group more connected between sessions 🙏
[4] (about=GROUP, said_by=Callum, group-insight, t10 @2025-03-08T10:05:00) Recommended scanning settings: 16-bit greyscale, Adobe RGB, 2400 dpi minimum.
[5] (about=Fen, episodic, t2 @2025-02-08T10:14:00) in and out today, field trip this afternoon. scan-sharing would have helped me last month. I'm for it.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Margot, group-insight, t10 @2025-03-08T10:05:00) Scan-sharing serves a purpose for including absent members, distinct from scanning as general practice.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nora, group-interaction, t9 @2025-03-08T10:03:00) Scan-sharing trial: anyone who printed last week must send a scan at 2400 dpi minimum to shared folder by Wednesday.
[8] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-insight, t10 @2025-03-08T10:05:00) Scan resolution affects readability of fine detail; worth agreeing a minimum standard per print type.
[9] (about=Sol, episodic, t2 @2025-02-08T10:23:00) lowkey think scan-sharing is a great idea, highkey would have helped when I missed the November session @everyone 🙌 also I can help people with the scanning settings if needed
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Yuki, group-insight, t10 @2025-03-08T10:05:00) Scan resolution should be agreed per print rather than set as a blanket standard.
agent_answer:
C. Otto

Otto’s response revealed that he was reluctant about scan-sharing and preferred in-person attendance. He framed scanning as “a compromise,” argued that digitisation loses tonal range from wet prints, stated “the print is the work,” and said “I would rather members attended.” The telling part is how he opened: “I will say what needs saying,” which signals he saw himself as voicing an uncomfortable or dissenting view; then he softened it with “That said, I understand the practical argument,” showing he accepted the arrangement despite his personal reservations.
